question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution is related to the Directive Principles of State Policy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Articles 36-51**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Directive Principles of State Policy** are enshrined in **Articles 36-51** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• These principles are guidelines for the creation of a social order characterized by social, economic, and political justice.
 
• The Directive Principles aim to establish a** welfare state** in India.
 
• They are **non-justiciable**, meaning they are not enforceable by any court, but they are** fundamental in the governance of the country.**
 
• The principles include provisions related to** adequate means of livelihood, equal pay for equal work, protection of children, and promotion of educational and economic interests** of the weaker sections of society.
 
• They are inspired by the Irish Constitution and also reflect the ideals set out in the Preamble of the Indian Constitution.
